I think my favorite birthday party I've ever had was a few years ago. My parents house has a pool. They were put of town for something and my SO asked if he could host a birthday party for me there. He said to meet me at my house after work because he wanted to have some beers and swim with me. I get off work pretty late so it was dark. I get home and go outside to find him and there's a bonfire going, balloons tied around the yard and all of my friends were in the pool to yell surprise when I flicked the backyard light on. I didn't expect a thing. I cried. I swear I'm not even a crier, but these kinds of things really make me feel overwhelmingly grateful.

My SO bought 400 glow sticks and threw them all in the pool. I remember seeing all of them the pool before I turned on the lights and was like dafuq? So we got wasted and swam and listened to electronic music all night and got in a glow stick war. We found glow sticks in the yard for a couple years after that. I'm very thankful for my friends and family.

So yeah. For my birthday I like to eat lobsters and I would have a glow stick pool party every year for the rest of my life if I could.
